dataset: Per-instance outputs of HELM Classic release v0.4.0 (Stanford CRFM): every wikifact k=5 run listed in runs_to_run_suites.json, test split, all trials, all five completions. Only run names, instance ids, trials, classes, counts and public model names are published.
note: H = HELM's EM (quasi_exact_match of the completion with the highest log probability, stable sort; gated against every stored record score). F = the first completion (what HELM's prediction page shows). M = mean over the returned completions (single-sample accuracy). K = any completion (quasi_exact_match@5). Run class: zero_logprob if >= 90% of records have every logprob 0, else collapsed if >= 90% have one distinct text, else ranked. Cells: mean over the adapter's runs of each run's mean of trial means, only when every listed run is included. disagree_keys: up to 20 [instance id, trial] per run where F != H.
